record.title: Export timeout
record.excerpt: For Signal Desk 2.4, retry the export with a date range of seven days or fewer. If that fails, escalate with the job identifier. Do not claim an outage is resolved.

final_response.reply: Please retry your Signal Desk 2.4 export with a date range of seven days or fewer. If it still times out, share the job identifier so support can investigate.
final_response.reason: Retrieved KB-EXPORT-2 applies to version 2.4 and supports reducing the date range, then escalating with the job identifier if the retry fails. Local draft only.
